line: Every day, your team sends hundreds of these.
Requests. Approvals. Little “can you take a look at this?”s.
And somewhere in there… one of them stalls.
No one dropped it on purpose. It just… slipped.
Three days later, it’s a missed deadline, an angry customer… and a very awkward meeting.
Nudgebird watches the work flowing through your tools…
…and catches the moment something starts to stall.
Connect your tools in two minutes.
It learns what normal looks like, and flags what isn’t.
Then it nudges exactly the right person. No nagging. No blame.
And nobody spends their week chasing people.
So you can stop babysitting tasks, and get back to the work that actually matters.
Nudgebird. Nothing falls through the cracks.
